verdict.rationale: Thoropass ships a native Risk Register. It offers configurable 4×4 or 5×5 risk scoring and lets you track, evaluate, and remediate risks. Risks can be assigned to a role that modifies the controls and action items linked to them, which covers scored risks, owners, treatment via action items, and control linkage. Evidence is mostly marketing-level, and recurring risk review cycles are not documented beyond a generic 'proactively review' claim. missing for 10: documented recurring risk review cycles/reminders, explicit treatment-plan structure (accept/mitigate/transfer), in-depth help-center docs and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a security engineer, a real risk register lives in the platform — scored risks, treatment plans, owners, and review cycles tied back to controls

citations.quote: Quickly stand up your dashboard in a flexible 4×4 or 5×5 risk configuration to meet your unique business needs and risk assessment methodology
The new role can manage assigned risks in Risk Register, including modifying controls and action items linked to those risks, streamlining risk accountability and improving efficiency.
Thoropass Risk Register provides a 360-degree view into your risk landscape, enabling you to efficiently track, evaluate, and remediate risk
With the Thoropass Risk Register, proactively review and mitigate risk in the same platform
